name: life-dashboard
title: Life Dashboard
description: Your life at a glance: progress, milestones, countdowns, seasons, Ramadans and Christmases, fun body stats, a life grid, and a menu bar — memento mori, but make it fun.
author: ezz_hassan

commands.name: life-progress
commands.title: Life Progress
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Everything at a glance: progress, celebrated moments, body stats, remaining time, work life, countdowns, and milestones — with a quote to set the tone.

commands.name: life-grid
commands.title: Life Grid
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Your whole life as a grid of months — colored by life stage, one row per year.

commands.name: life-menubar
commands.title: Life Progress Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Pin your life progress to the macOS menu bar — the dropdown carries stats, countdowns, and the next milestone.

commands.name: toggle-menubar
commands.title: Toggle Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Show or hide the Life Progress menu bar item.

commands.name: create-countdown
commands.title: Create Countdown
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Count down to any date — see days, weeks, months, and years remaining in the dashboard and menu bar.

commands.name: manage-countdowns
commands.title: Manage Countdowns
commands.subtitle: Life Dashboard
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete your countdowns.

preferences.name: birthday
preferences.title: Birthday
preferences.description: Your birthday, format 1995-01-01 — the anchor for every stat.

preferences.name: deathAge
preferences.title: Life Expectancy (years)
preferences.description: Used for remaining-time stats. Default 80, minimum 50.

preferences.name: workStartDate
preferences.title: First Working Day
preferences.description: For paycheck and work-life stats, format 2019-09-01. Leave empty to hide the Work section.

preferences.name: paycheckCadence
preferences.title: Paycheck Cadence
preferences.description: How often you get paid, for the paychecks counter.

preferences.name: weekStart
preferences.title: Week Start
preferences.description: The day your week starts, for days-left-this-week.

preferences.name: progressSymbol
preferences.title: Progress Bar Symbol
preferences.description: Symbol used for text progress bars.

preferences.name: showQuotes
preferences.label: Show a quote in Life Progress and the menu bar
preferences.description: Open Life Progress and the menu bar with a rotating memento-mori quote.

preferences.name: showChristmas
preferences.label: Show Christmases celebrated
preferences.description: Count the Christmases you have celebrated.

preferences.name: showRamadan
preferences.label: Show Ramadans lived
preferences.description: Count the Ramadans you have lived (Umm al-Qura calendar).

preferences.name: showLunarYears
preferences.label: Show lunar (Hijri) years
preferences.description: Count the lunar (Hijri) years you have witnessed.
